svg.title: coderprint: 696k lines of code in use, of 1.0M written, all time
svg.desc: 695,905 lines of code in use (467,203 in production, 228,702 in tests), of 1,015,226 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 3,035 commits across all branches, 62 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 7 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 940k lines of code. The bars end on 24OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 45%, Lean 26%, Python 16%, TypeScript 8%, JavaScript 4%, other languages 1%. Of what was written, 69% is kept.
